kicker: Administration · applies to the whole instance

link.label: Link
link.hint: Expires on {{expires}} and works only once. This link will not be shown again.
link.once: This link will not be shown again.
link.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.

empty.title: No sources yet
empty.body: Sources feed the reports and the ideas. Add Hacker News, TabNews, Lobsters, dev.to, a subreddit, a YouTube channel, Mastodon, Bluesky, GitHub, Product Hunt or any RSS feed.

collect.failed: The collection of {{name}} failed. See the status of the source.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The source and the items it collected are removed. This cannot be undone.
delete.hasCitedItems: {{name}} cannot be deleted: reports or ideas cite its items. Disable it instead.

sheet.newDescription: Pick where the news come from. The first collection runs right after you save.

form.name: Name
form.subredditHint: The prefix r/ is optional. Uses Reddit's public JSON.
form.channelIdHint: We read the channel's public RSS; no key needed.
form.urlHint: RSS or Atom. The feed is validated when you save.
form.lobstersTagHint: Optional. When set, the list above is ignored and the tag's stories are read.
form.devtoTagHint: Optional. Leave empty for articles of any tag.
form.mastodonAccountHint: user, or user@other.host when the account lives on another server.
form.bskyActorHint: The posts of this account, for example bsky.app. No login needed.
form.bskyFeedHint: An at:// URI or a https://bsky.app/profile/…/feed/… link. No login needed.
form.bskyQueryHint: Bluesky only allows searching when logged in.
form.bskyIdentifierHint: The handle or e-mail that logs in with the app password below.
form.ghQueryHint: Optional. Words to look for in the repositories.
form.phTopicHint: Optional. The topic's slug, as in producthunt.com/topics/<slug>.

hint.bluesky: Create an app password in Bluesky under Settings → Privacy and security.
hint.github: A personal access token raises the GitHub rate limit.
hint.producthunt: Create a developer token at producthunt.com/v2/oauth/applications.

secret.requiredHint: {{what}} Stored encrypted. It will not be shown again.
secret.optionalHint: Optional. {{what}} Stored encrypted. It will not be shown again.
secret.savedHint: A credential is configured. Leave empty to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.description: Local models (Ollama, llama.cpp, LM Studio) use the OpenAI-compatible type. Keys are encrypted and never shown again.

empty.title: No AI provider yet
empty.body: Reports and ideas are written by a model. Connect a local server or a hosted provider to get started.

form.name: Name
form.baseUrlRequired: Where the server answers, for example http://ollama:11434/v1.
form.baseUrlOptional: Optional. Leave empty to use the provider's address.
form.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted. It will not be shown again.
form.newKeyHint: Current key: {{hint}}. Leave empty to keep it.

found.hint: Add the models you want to use: chat models write reports and ideas, embedding models rank and compare.

test.title: Connection with {{name}}
test.body: We list the models the provider offers. Add the ones you want to use.
test.noDetail: The provider gave no further details.
test.noModels: The provider answered but lists no models. Pull or load one and test again.

add.title: Add a provider
add.body: We test the connection right after saving.
add.connectedBody: Check the connection and add the models you want to use.

edit.title: Edit {{name}}
edit.body: Change the name or the address. A new key replaces the old one.
edit.keyBody: The new key replaces the current one and is never shown again.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The provider and its models are removed. Settings that use them are cleared.

models.title: Enabled models
models.hint: Only enabled models are offered to users.
models.empty: No models yet. Test a provider connection and add the models you want to use.
models.deleteBody: The model is removed from the instance. Settings that use it are cleared.

settings.title: Instance settings
settings.noEmbedding: No embedding model yet. Add one from a provider connection test.

embeddings.title: Embeddings
embeddings.body: Used to rank news and to avoid repeated ideas.
embeddings.label: Embedding model
embeddings.warning: Changing the embedding model reindexes everything: items, ideas and user interests. Reports and ideas wait until it finishes.

defaults.title: Defaults for new users
defaults.body: Each user can change them in their own profile.
defaults.byokBody: Each user can connect their own OpenAI, Anthropic or Gemini key and use those models in reports and ideas. When off, the keys stay stored and everyone uses the instance models.

similarity.title: Ideas without repetition
similarity.body: Above this similarity, the model decides whether the candidate is the same idea and, if so, merges it into a new version.
similarity.label: Similarity threshold

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Items cited in reports or ideas are never deleted.
retention.label: Keep collected items for (days)

reindex.running: Reindexing in progress. Reports and ideas wait until it finishes.
reindex.failed: The reindex failed. Try changing the embedding model again.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.body: Who can create an account and when idle accounts pause.
accounts.signupBody: Anyone can create a member account. The e-mail must be confirmed before reports and ideas are generated.
accounts.noMail: Set up SMTP first (SMTP_HOST and MAIL_FROM) to turn sign-up on.
accounts.inactivity: Pause accounts with no access after (days)
accounts.inactivityHint: 0 turns it off. Idle accounts get no reports or ideas until they come back.

users.title: Users
users.description: Invite people by link or e-mail; public sign-up is turned on in Settings. Links expire and work only once.

reset.title: Reset link for {{name}}
reset.body: Send it to the person by any channel. It replaces older reset links.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.body: The person is signed out and cannot sign in until you reactivate the account.

makeAdmin.title: Make {{name}} an admin?
makeAdmin.body: Admins manage sources, AI providers and users of the whole instance.

makeMember.title: Make {{name}} a member?
makeMember.body: The person loses access to the administration screens.

invite.title: Invite a person
invite.body: Pick the role. The link is created in the next step.
invite.readyBody: Send it to the person by any channel. They choose name and password when they open it.

roleHint.admin: Also manages sources, AI providers and users.

invite.emailHint: We send the invite by e-mail and the account must use this address.
invite.emailed: Invite sent to {{email}}. You can still copy the link below.

invites.title: Pending invites
invites.revokeBody: The link stops working right away.

ai.title: Connect an AI model
ai.body: It writes the reports and the ideas. You can start with a local model and add other providers later, under Administration.
ai.composeBody: The Ollama of the compose file answers at {{url}}. Pull the models with make models.
ai.noChat: Add a chat model above to pick it here.
ai.noEmbedding: Add an embedding model above to pick it here.
ai.embeddingWarning: Without an embedding model, news ranking and idea de-duplication stay off. You can add one later.

sources.title: Pick your first sources
sources.body: Sources are where the news come from. Start with a few and add more later, under Administration.
sources.count_zero: No sources yet. You can finish and add them later.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.SOURCE_HAS_CITED_ITEMS: This source has items cited by reports or ideas. Disable it instead.
errors.PROVIDER_NAME_TAKEN: There is already a provider with this name.
errors.MODEL_EXISTS: This model is already added to the provider.
errors.EMBEDDINGS_UNSUPPORTED: This provider does not offer embedding models.
errors.AI_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: The model is unavailable. Check the provider and try again.
errors.CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ACCESS: You cannot change your own role or status.
errors.LAST_ADMIN: At least one active admin must remain.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this e-mail already exists.
errors.MAILER_NOT_CONFIGURED: E-mail delivery is not configured. Set SMTP_HOST and MAIL_FROM on the server.
